evidence.note: Inspected run.sh, oracle_fixtures/ and the Excel-value oracle JSON files up front, understanding the provided ground-truth verification apparatus but adopting it rather than extending it.
Ran run.sh per-suite against the live server as a regression gate, iterating fix→restart→re-run; treated the smoke suite pass/fail as the primary correctness signal throughout.

Spot-checked representative formulas and error behavior with manual curl (VLOOKUP, MAP ghost values, LET/LAMBDA, error kinds) to debug — targeted value/sentinel checks but only as debugging aids, not new coverage.
Noticed persistence incidentally when a restarted server reloaded prior workbooks; persistence was observed, not deliberately tested as an invariant.

Ran the full smoke suite repeatedly for an aggregate count (122/131), and declared done on that basis; never probed the stated performance budgets (100k-cell import, 5000-dependent propagation) or built any check the smoke suite omits.

reasoning: The agent consistently uses run.sh as a regression gate against the live server and spot-checks representative formulas and error sentinels via curl — squarely the anchor-5 behavior. It never builds checks the smoke suite omits: no independent Excel ground-truth tables (it relies on the provided oracle fixtures), no deliberate restart-persistence or XLSX re-import invariants of its own, and crucially zero timing against the performance budgets — so it does not reach anchor 8. It goes beyond anchor 3 by using tests as a genuine gate and spot-checking values, landing firmly at 5.
